The labels on the keypad buttons are illegible smudges. They lack the sharp edges and distinct characters expected of printed keys on a manufactured device, appearing slightly melted or fused into the button surface.
The left and right edges of the device show slight waviness and inconsistency in thickness, lacking the perfect straightness of a molded plastic chassis.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'text_gibberish' artifact on the screen. In real devices, even low-res screens show pixel grids or distinct UI shapes.
